## Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 New Feature (`feat`)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug Fix (`fix`)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation Update (`docs`)
- [ ] ♻️ Code Refactor (`refactor`)
- [ ] 🧪 Test Additions / Improvements (`test`)
- [ ] ⚙️ Maintenance / Chore (`chore`)

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] Ran `python -m jobhunt validate` and it passed with 0 errors.
- [ ] Ran `pytest -v` and all unit & integration tests pass.
- [ ] Verified Typst PDF compilation succeeds (if templates or PDF generation touched).

## Privacy & Hygiene Checklist
- [ ] Zero candidate PII (names, emails, phones, private career facts) committed to code or Typst templates.
- [ ] No `config/profile.yaml`, `data/*.sqlite`, or `.env` files staged or tracked.
- [ ] Commits follow conventional commit standards (`feat:`, `fix:`, etc.).
